# Notes CLI: add and list

## 1. Problem
A dependency-free `notes` CLI is needed; nothing works yet.

## 2. Solution
`node src/notes.js add <text>` appends a note to `notes.json` in the current directory; `node src/notes.js list` prints notes one per line in insertion order.

## 3. Scope
| In | Out |
| --- | --- |
| add, list, README usage | search, edit, clear (a later change) |

## 4. Requirements
#### R-01 — add and list
- Scenario: `add first`, `add second`, `list` prints `first\nsecond\n`.
- Failure path: `add` without text exits 1 with a one-line message.
- Preserve: nothing existing.
#### R-02 — documented usage
- Scenario: README shows both commands.

## 5. Architecture
One file `src/notes.js`, JSON storage in the working directory, tests with `node:test` (`npm test`).

## 6. Success criteria
`npm test` passes; README documents add and list.

## 7. Out of scope
clear (PRD v2), any other command.

## Authorization
Profile small: the brief settles every decision; no questions.
